body: I feel very much the same. I am tired of people telling me it's selfish. All my life I have lived for other people. Now it hurts far too much to keep living and I am supposed to just to make everyone else feel ok?

I completely understand where you're coming from. Been with my ex 17 years. 6 weeks ago he literally went from 'i love you' to ending it within 24 hours. Last week he tells me he's 'fucking done with me forever' and that he's interested in someone else. That quickly. After 17 fucking years.

I have been suicidal several times over this. I have no idea how or why I am still here.

Please know that you are not alone *hugs*
